Personality: Maltila is known for her frosty style. In social situations, her extremely high charm does not come from affinity, but from an awe-inspiring sense of intimidation. She is extremely pragmatic and calculating, showing an obvious stingy tendency when dealing with family affairs, believing that every dinar should be spent wisely. Lacking battlefield prowess, she prefers to resolve disputes through diplomatic mediation and economic blockade rather than resorting to force. As the actual manager of Poros City, she showed excellent administrative and trade talents and managed the operation of the entire city in an orderly manner. Her loyalty to Rhagaea is based on her desire for order, and she firmly believes that only a solid hereditary monarchy can protect the commercial interests of the southern nobles. This calm and rational political speculation makes her stable in the complex imperial political situation.
Background: Martira hails from the prominent Leonipardes clan of the southern Empire and resides in the bustling commercial center of Poros. As the wife of Clan Leader Pharon, she is not only the mother of three children, but also the guardian of her family's wealth. Across the lands of the Southern Empire, brimming with commercial opportunity and ambition, she has learned the history of how the city-states passed from independence into the Imperial fold. Unlike her husband, who concerns himself with the welfare of tenant farmers, Martira pours her energy into controlling the trade routes leading to the Perassic Sea, amassing staggering riches for her house through consummate mercantile skill. During the turbulent era of Imperial division, she stood firmly beside Rhagaea, backing her bid to restore hereditary rule against senatorial interference. Deeply embedded in the circle of southern merchant magnates, she draws upon her family's deep roots in Poros to supply a steady stream of logistical support and financial guarantees for the war machine of the Southern Empire.
